channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Elon Musk sues OpenAI, Microsoft for billions over alleged fraud in AI partnership
item.description: Musk's lawyers filed the damages request a day after a judge denied OpenAI and Microsoft's final bid to avoid a jury trial scheduled for late April in Oakland, California, according to multiple reports. The filing cited calculations that showed Musk is entitled to a share of OpenAI's current $500 billion valuation as he donated $38 million in seed funding during the founding stage of the company in 2015.

item.title: Bijapur encounter: DRG jawans kill two Maoists, recover AK-47s in forest clash
item.description: Officials said the gunfight erupted this morning in the north-western forested and hilly terrain of Bijapur district following specific intelligence inputs about the presence of armed Maoist cadres.

item.title: Trump discloses $100 million in bond purchases, invests in Netflix and Warner Bros Discovery debt amid $83 bn deal
item.description: US President Donald Trump purchased about $100 million worth of municipal and corporate bonds between mid-November and late December, according to recent financial disclosures. Most of the investments were in municipal bonds issued by cities, school districts, utilities and hospitals, but he also bought corporate bonds from companies such as Netflix, Warner Bros Discovery, Boeing, Occidental Petroleum and General Motors

item.title: Metro fare hike unacceptable, BJP will protest: Tejasvi Surya
item.description: "Bengaluru Metro is now the most expensive metro in the country. As a result, common people are hesitant to use it. Compared to Delhi, Chennai, and Kochi metros, where the fare for a 10 km ride is much lower, Bengaluru's metro fare is double," said Tejasvi Surya.

item.title: 'Stop associating my name with Talwiinder': Sony Kaur denies being his ex-girlfriend amid Disha Patani dating rumours
item.description: Model Sony Kaur took to Instagram to clarify rumours linking her to singer Talwiinder after her cryptic post went viral, with many netizens speculating that it was a dig at his rumoured relationship with Disha Patani. Interestingly, Disha's alleged ex-boyfriends Tiger Shroff and Alex were also present at Nupur–Stebin's reception, along with her alleged current partner, Talwiinde.

item.title: Box office collection day 5: Mana Shankara Varaprasad Garu grosses Rs 226 crore
item.description: Mana Shankara Varaprasad Garu has become the highest grossing movie for megastar Chiranjeevi with its collection of Rs 226 crore gross.

item.title: MHA Calls LAB, KDA for Fresh Talks on Ladakh Demands on February 4
item.description: Ending weeks of speculation, the Union Ministry of Home Affairs has convened a fresh round of talks with Ladakh's agitating groups, including the Leh Apex Body and the Kargil Democratic Alliance, on February 4 in New Delhi.

item.title: Minor 4.1-magnitude earthquake shakes Kutch ahead of Bhuj quake anniversary
item.description: The latest earthquake came just a day after a 2.5 magnitude tremor was recorded in Rapar on Friday evening at around 5:47 p.m.

item.title: Body of missing Kerala tourist recovered from Arunachal's frozen Sela Lake
item.description: On receiving information, an Indian Army rescue team from the Gajraj Corps was immediately mobilised. Despite extreme weather conditions, sub-zero temperatures and the challenges of operating in a high-altitude area, Army divers, along with the police and civil administration, conducted prompt rescue operations.

item.title: PM Modi honours MGR on Jayanti, recalls his legacy in governance and society
item.description: PM Modi in his post on X said, "Paying homage to the exceptional MGR on his Jayanti. His contribution to Tamil Nadu's progress is outstanding. Equally noteworthy is his role in popularising Tamil culture. We will always keep working to realise his vision for our society."
